blocks.text: Yeh rule batata hai ke barabar energy wale orbitals mein electrons kaise bharein. Maslan teen p-orbitals px, py aur pz ki energy barabar hai. Farz karein teen electrons teen p-orbitals mein rakhne hain. Is ke do tareeqe ho sakte hain:

blocks.alt: px, py aur pz khanon mein teen electrons rakhne ke do tareeqe. I (wrong): px mein ulte spin ke do electrons, py mein ek, pz khaali. II (right): px, py aur pz har ek mein ek electron, sab ka ek hi spin.
blocks.caption: Hund ka rule: px, py aur pz ko bharne ka I (ghalat) aur II (sahi) tareeqa (kitab ke 2.7.4 mein be-unwan diagram ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tareeqa I mein do electrons px mein jora bana lete hain aur pz khaali hai; ek orbital mein do electrons ek doosre ko zyada dhakelte (repel) hain, is liye yeh ghalat hai. Tareeqa II mein har box mein ek electron hai aur teeno teer ek hi taraf (same spin) hain; yahi sahi hai.
Kaun sa sahi hai? Jawab Hund ka rule deta hai:

blocks.title: Hund ka rule
blocks.text: Jab degenerate (barabar energy wale) orbitals maujood hon aur un mein electrons rakhne hon, to pehle har orbital mein ek ek electron same spin ke saath rakha jata hai; jora (pair) tab banta hai jab koi khaali orbital na bache.
Hund ke rule ke mutabiq teen p orbitals mein teen electrons bharne ka sahi tareeqa woh hai jis mein har orbital mein sirf ek electron ho.

blocks.prompt: Oxygen ke 2p subshell (chaar 2p electrons) ka orbital diagram banayein.
blocks.explanation: Teen box px, py, pz. Hund ke rule se pehle teeno mein ek ek ↑ jata hai. Chautha electron ab jora banata hai: px mein ↓, Pauli ke principle ke mutabiq ulte spin ke saath. Nateeja: px ↑↓, py ↑, pz ↑.

blocks.alt: Do qadam: oopar teen 2p boxes mein ek ek oopar wala teer (electrons 1, 2, 3, Hund ka rule). Neeche chautha electron (laal, neeche wala teer) 2px box mein jora banata hai; nateeja 2px ↑↓, 2py ↑, 2pz ↑.
blocks.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): oxygen ke chaar 2p electrons ka orbital diagram
blocks.long_description: Pehla qadam: Hund ke rule ke mutabiq pehle teen electrons teeno 2p boxes mein ek ek jate hain, sab ek hi spin ke saath. Doosra qadam: chautha electron (laal teer) 2px mein jata hai aur Pauli ke principle ke mutabiq ulta spin rakhta hai. Aakhir mein 2px mein jora aur 2py, 2pz mein ek ek unpaired electron.

items: Hund: barabar energy wale orbitals mein pehle har orbital mein ek electron, same spin; phir jora.
Teen p electrons: px, py, pz mein ek ek.
